articles.title: Repeat offender landlords fined over £200,000 in total
articles.summary: Two landlords have been fined over £216,000 after renting out homes in a dangerous condition.  The penalties relate to properties in Norfolk following a crackdown by Breckland council officers on homes owned by repeat-offending landlords. One landlord, who lets 11 properties in the area, was fined £64,800 for failing to carry out electrical safety checks. […]
articles.ai_summary:
- Two repeat-offender landlords in Norfolk hit with fines totaling over £216,000 for renting out unsafe homes, as part of Breckland council's stricter enforcement.  
- One landlord, managing 11 properties, was specifically fined £64,800 for neglecting mandatory electrical safety checks.
